==Usage==
<nowiki>{{FilmDate|number}}</nowiki>, where ''number'' is either a Roman numeral I-IX or a number 1-9. There is no difference between using a Roman numeral such as IV or its Arabic numeral equivalent 4. {{Para|number|}} can also be "Solo" or "Rogue One" exactly as in those quotes.
